title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 248 ]

blocks.text: A small number of people have recognized the value of wild plants in Korea. They are fascinated by the beauty of these plants and have been motivated to conserve them after discovering the tragic realities these plants face. Because of indifference to and destruction of their natural habitats, some wild plants confront an uncertain future. Given this situation, these people have striven to conserve the wild plants growing in Korea. They have taught the public to value plant species and launched efforts to preserve wild plants for generations to come. Thanks to these efforts, more Koreans now understand the full value of their precious wild plants.

readingSentences.english: A small number of people have recognized the value of wild plants in Korea.
readingSentences.korean: 많지 않은 수의 사람들이 한국에 있는 야생 식물들의 소중함을 깨달았다.

readingSentences.english: They are fascinated by the beauty of these plants and have been motivated to conserve them after discovering the tragic realities these plants face.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 이 야생 식물의 아름다움에 매료되었고, 이 식물들이 직면한 비극적인 현실을 발견하고 나서 이것들을 보호해야 한다는 동기를 갖게 되었다.

readingSentences.english: Because of indifference to and destruction of their natural habitats, some wild plants confront an uncertain future.
readingSentences.korean: 야생 식물들의 자연 서식지에 대한 무관심과 그 파괴때문에, 몇몇의 야생 식물들의 미래는 불확실한 상태이다.

readingSentences.english: Given this situation, these people have striven to conserve the wild plants growing in Korea.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 상황이 되자 이러한 사람들은 한국에서 자라고 있는 야생 식물들을 보존하는데 애쓰기 시작했다.

readingSentences.english: They have taught the public to value plant species and launched efforts to preserve wild plants for generations to come.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 대중들에게 식물들의 가치를 알리고, 다음 세대에서도 이 야생 식물들이 보존될 수 있도록 애쓰고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Thanks to these efforts, more Koreans now understand the full value of their precious wild plants.
readingSentences.korean: 그들의 노력으로 현재는 많은 한국인들이 야생 식물들의 가치를 충분히 이해한다.
